hero.title: North Wind Restaurant: A Landmark for Fine Dining
hero.subtitle: Savor Coorg & Mangalorean Culinary Delights Amidst an Elegant Ambiance and Stunning Roof Garden Views.

about.title: The Legacy of North Wind Restaurant
about.paragraph1: Welcome to North Wind Restaurant! Discover innovations in fine dining and an unparalleled roof garden experience. From our exquisite dining halls to the serene outdoor setting, we invite you to savor the ambiance until your favorite cuisine arrives at your table. It was in 1988 that North Wind Restaurant first graced North Bangalore, quickly establishing itself as a beacon of culinary excellence.
about.paragraph2: Inaugurated by the former Prime Minister of India, Sri HD Deve Gowda, North Wind Restaurant immediately possessed all the makings of a landmark for connoisseurs of fine dining. Like the enticing aroma from our kitchen, the word quickly spread about North Wind Restaurant's delectable delicacies, particularly our authentic Coorg and Mangalorean culinary delights, a tradition we proudly uphold today.
